## Purpose

The Analysis Data Model (ADaM) provides standard structures and conventions for datasets used in statistical analysis. A useful ADaM dataset makes the path from source data to a reported result understandable.

## Core ideas

ADaM emphasizes analysis readiness, metadata, and traceability. Common structures include subject-level analysis data and basic data structure datasets.

## A practical check

For every important result, a reviewer should be able to identify the analysis records, variables, derivations, and source information that contributed to it.
